prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Chicago. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Chicago for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — before I give specific names I need a few quick details so I can pick the best local options for you. Please answer any of the following that apply:

- Which Chicago neighborhood(s) are most convenient for you (e.g., Lincoln Park, Lakeview, River North, South Loop, West Loop, Oak Park, Evanston, etc.)?  
- Are you an adult or a child/teen? (Treatment approach and doctor selection can differ.)  
- Do you have a preference for braces (metal/ceramic/self-ligating) or clear aligners (Invisalign/byte/other)?  
- Do you have dental insurance (orthodontic coverage)? Will you need payment plans?  
- Any special priorities: fastest treatment, lowest cost, most discreet, advanced/complex orthognathic cases, weekend/evening hours, or doctors who treat TMJ?  
- Are you open to traveling 30–45 minutes, or do you need something within walking/public-transit distance?

What I’ll do once you reply:
- Give a short list (4–7) of specific Chicago-area orthodontists/clinics to call, tailored to your location and needs. For each I’ll include why I’m recommending them (experience with Invisalign vs braces, reputation, convenient hours, technology like iTero scans or 3D imaging, insurance/financing friendliness), plus suggested questions to ask on the phone.
- If you want, I’ll include typical cost ranges and what to expect at the first consult.

If you want a quick immediate start and don’t care about neighborhood: say so and I’ll pull a general list of well-reviewed Chicago orthodontists and why to call them. Which do you prefer?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
